title: MuMu Android device tools
description: Controls only a MuMu instance selected and locally authorized for an unattendedDev workspace.
redLines: No screenshots outside the foreground test app

tools.name: list_mumu_instances
tools.description: Discover MuMu VMs through mumu-cli info -v all. This reads metadata only and does not start or modify instances.

tools.name: get_mumu_status
tools.description: Check the locally selected MuMu VM and its ADB connection. Requires a local workspace selection.

tools.name: start_mumu_if_needed
tools.description: Start only the locally selected existing MuMu instance if it is stopped. Never creates, deletes, resets, or shuts down a VM.

tools.name: get_android_devices
tools.description: Check ADB state through MuMu CLI for the selected instance only.

tools.name: install_debug_apk
tools.description: Install only the signed, hash-verified APK published by a successful assembleDebug task in this workspace on the selected MuMu instance.

tools.name: launch_android_app
tools.description: Launch the package and launcher verified from a published build artifact on the selected MuMu instance.

tools.name: stop_test_app
tools.description: Close only the test package from the published build artifact on the selected MuMu instance.

tools.name: get_logcat
tools.description: Return a bounded, redacted Logcat page filtered to the package/process from this build task.

tools.name: capture_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot only while the verified test package is the visible foreground app; store it under project .tmp/mumu and return its hash/path.

tools.name: dump_ui_hierarchy
tools.description: Dump UIAutomator hierarchy only while the verified test package is in the foreground and save it under project .tmp/mumu.

tools.name: run_android_instrumentation_or_uiautomator
tools.description: Run bounded tap/text/key UI automation against the foreground test app. No arbitrary Android shell command is accepted.

tools.name: collect_crash_diagnostics
tools.description: Collect target-package process/activity and filtered redacted crash lines without returning an unrestricted Logcat dump.

tools.name: validate_android_ui
tools.description: Check the target app process, foreground Activity, window, and Surface over at least three rounds; process existence alone does not pass validation.
